name: prefix-orphan-branches
description: Prefix remote branches that do not follow the gitflow config and have no pull request with orphan/.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token with contents:write and pull-requests:read permissions.

PREFIX.description: Prefix prepended to orphan branch names.

INIT_GITFLOW.description: When true, initialize git-flow with the branch inputs and default prefixes before running.

DRY_RUN.description: When true, only list the branches that would be renamed.

renamed-branches.description: Newline-separated list of old -> new renames. Empty when none.
